entity.summary: Open-source hardware wallet ecosystem with device-held offline private keys and current companion software.
entity.notes: Current first-party KeepKey material says the hardware wallet has secured crypto since 2014, stores private keys on the device, is currently in stock and receives free firmware updates for life. Year precision only.

products.summary: Current KeepKey hardware wallet with offline device-held private keys and open-source firmware/hardware design.
products.notes: Current first-party pages say the device is in stock and promise free firmware updates for life; WLR therefore records current sale and support explicitly.

events.title: ShapeShift acquired KeepKey
events.description: ShapeShift acquired the KeepKey hardware-wallet business in 2017 and integrated the hardware wallet with the ShapeShift platform.
events.notes: Reviewed first-party ShapeShift material consistently establishes the acquisition year as 2017 but does not provide a defensible exact acquisition day in this review, so WLR keeps year precision.

events.title: KeepKey returned to independent ownership
events.description: ShapeShift DAO material states that from January 1, 2022 KeepKey was independently owned and operated by its new owners after ShapeShift's decentralization and spinout of the hardware-wallet business.
events.notes: The current event taxonomy has no dedicated divestiture/spinout value, so this ownership change is conservatively recorded as other rather than misclassified as a rebrand, merger, or product launch.

evidence.title: KeepKey Hardware Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party KeepKey site states the wallet has existed since 2014, keeps private keys offline on the device, and is non-custodial/open source.

evidence.title: KeepKey — The wallet you can verify
evidence.notes: Current product page identifies the hardware wallet as current, links purchase/setup paths and states free firmware updates for life.

evidence.title: ShapeShift's KeepKey Support Grows
evidence.notes: First-party ShapeShift retrospective states that ShapeShift announced its acquisition of KeepKey in 2017 and later spun KeepKey back into its own entity during decentralization.

evidence.title: [SCP-71] Proposal to Create the KeepKey Workstream
evidence.notes: Official ShapeShift DAO governance material states that as of 2022-01-01 KeepKey was owned by its new owners and independently owned and operated. The post date is later than the effective ownership date and is not reused as the event date.
